name: Phishing Army blocklist
tier_rationale: Long-running community project (since 2019) with an identifiable maintainer and public documentation (A8 community).

reliability.justification: Aggregates PhishTank, OpenPhish, CERT.PL, urlscan.io and other feeds; its own value is coverage, not independent confirmation (counts as the families it embeds).

blocklist.title: Phishing Army domain blocklist (phishing_army_blocklist.txt)

terms.quote: Team Cymru MHR, Robtex, Malpedia, blocklist.de, CINS, ET, GreenSnow, DataPlane and Phishing Army = 'noncommercial' (A1 initial classes); P071 cond 4: Phishing Army (CC BY-NC, with OpenPhish upstream): off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared.

blocklist.notes: Quote: binding council text (A1, P071 cond 4). ~3.2 MB, refreshed every 6 h upstream; the harmless filtering-test domains (amiprotected.it) are dropped at index time. Non-commercial data: runtime download only (A6).
blocklist.licensed_alternative: A licence_allow entry backed by the maintainer's written permission (P071 cond 4); CERT.PL and Phishing.Database cover the category under open terms.
